evidence.detail: retire flow calls ps.associate(d, session['id']) to link Discord ID to MTGO username after retiring
add_signup() calls lg.signup(form) and redirects but never calls ps.associate — no Discord association happens at signup time even when session['id'] is set
associate() runs `UPDATE person SET discord_id = %s WHERE id = (SELECT person_id FROM deck WHERE id = %s) AND discord_id IS NULL` — safe: only sets if not already associated
league controller imports both `from flask import ... session` and `from decksite.data import person as ps` — all needed pieces are already in scope

triage.fix_sketch: In `decksite/controllers/league.py`, in `add_signup()` after `d = lg.signup(form)` (line ~47), add: `if session.get('id'): ps.associate(d, session['id'])`. This mirrors what the retire flow already does at line 95 and is safe because `associate()` only updates when `discord_id IS NULL`.
triage.notes: Both imports needed (session, ps) are already at the top of the file. The associate() guard prevents overwriting an existing association.
